title: On the Shelf Life of Finetuned LLM-Judges: Future Proofing, Backward Compatibility, and Question Generalization
authors_zh: Janvijay Singh，Austin Xu，Yilun Zhou，Yefan Zhou，Dilek Hakkani-Tür，Shafiq Joty。
paper_type_zh: 微调 LLM judge 的分布漂移与泛化可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 训练、更新或部署微调 pairwise judge 的团队。
one_line: Audits whether a finetuned judge remains reliable as questions and model generations shift.
审计微调 judge 面对新旧生成器与未见问题时的保鲜期，并表明持续训练更平衡。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fine-tuned judges are evaluated on fixed questions and generator outputs, although both change in deployment. A judge trained on yesterday’s responses may fail silently on newer models or new questions.

The paper models inputs as separate question and response distributions, then measures future-proofing, backward-compatibility, continual updating, and question generalization under controlled shifts.

微调 judge 往往只在固定问题、固定生成器输出上评估，但真实生成器和问题会变化。若 judge 只看过昨日模型的回答，面对更新模型或新问题可能悄然失效，常规榜单无法显示这种保鲜期风险。

论文将 judge 输入拆为问题与响应两种分布，并在受控漂移下测量未来适应、向后兼容、持续更新和问题泛化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a dual-distribution shelf-life audit. Pairwise judges train on weak or strong generator responses and are evaluated across response and question shifts with SFT, DPO and SFT+DPO, including continual DPO. It uses DeepScaleR and MMLU-Pro with verifiable labels; official code/data are released through the project repository.
核心贡献是双分布保鲜期审计：pairwise judge 在弱或强生成器响应上训练，再跨响应和问题漂移评估，比较 SFT、DPO、SFT+DPO 及持续 DPO。它使用带可验证标签的 DeepScaleR、MMLU-Pro；官方项目仓库发布代码与数据处理资源。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Label sampled responses as correct/incorrect using gold answers, then pair one of each from a single generator.
  2. Cluster generators by 20-sample Pass@1 into weak and strong response distributions; split questions into seen and unseen.
  3. Train Llama-3.1-8B, Ministral-8B and Mistral-24B judges with SFT, DPO or SFT+DPO; use consistent accuracy.
  4. Compare weak-to-strong, strong-to-weak and continual DPO shifts. Acceptance is objective pair correctness; model versions, sampled responses and question split must be fixed.

1. 用标准答案将采样响应标为正确或错误，再从同一生成器取一对。
  2. 以每题 20 次采样的 Pass@1 将生成器聚为弱、强响应分布，并切分已见、未见问题。
  3. 对 Llama-3.1-8B、Ministral-8B、Mistral-24B judge 训练 SFT、DPO、SFT+DPO，以一致准确率评估。
  4. 比较弱到强、强到弱及持续 DPO 漂移。接受规则是成对答案客观正确；版本、采样响应和问题切分必须固定。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On DeepScaleR, all weak-response-trained judges have negative FutureProof values (Fig. 3), showing degradation on strong responses. Refreshing on strong responses is positive in every setting; DPO reaches +7.6 absolute points for Mistral-24B. Strong-trained judges are comparatively backward-compatible, and continual DPO moves FutureProof closer to zero (Figs. 4–6). The result supports updating under these generators/datasets, not universal temporal generalization.
DeepScaleR 上，所有弱响应训练 judge 的 FutureProof 均为负（图 3），说明面对强响应会退化；改用强响应刷新在全部设置均为正，Mistral-24B 的 DPO 最高 +7.6 个绝对点。强响应训练 judge 相对更具向后兼容性，持续 DPO 会使 FutureProof 更接近零（图 4–6）。结论只支持这些生成器、数据集下的更新需要，不能推出普适时间泛化。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing judge work compares methods on static responses. This paper changes the object to evolving response and question distributions, distinguishing future-proofing from backward compatibility. SFT/DPO are not new; the contribution is a deployment-time generalization contract.
既有 judge 工作多在静态响应上比较训练法。本文把对象改为变化的响应、问题分布，明确区分未来适应和向后兼容。SFT/DPO 并不新；贡献是部署时可测的泛化判决契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Only two verifiable reasoning datasets and selected generator clusters are tested.
  2. Continual learning is restricted to DPO on DeepScaleR for compute reasons.
  3. Weak/strong is defined by Pass@1, combining capability, style and family effects. Deployment should measure its target generator distribution directly.

1. 只测两类可验证推理数据与选定的生成器簇。
  2. 受算力限制，持续学习只在 DeepScaleR 上做 DPO。
  3. 弱/强由 Pass@1 定义，混合了能力、风格和家族效应；部署应直接测目标生成器分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Before replacing a production judge, construct old/new generator and seen/unseen-question splits, report consistent accuracy and both direction shifts, then refresh only if the target shift improves. A fixed in-distribution score is not evidence of future-proofing.
替换生产 judge 前，应构造新旧生成器、已见未见问题切分，报告一致准确率及双向漂移；只有目标漂移改善才刷新。固定同分布分数不能作为未来适应的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Shelf life is response/question shift, not static accuracy.
  2. Weak/strong generators use 20-sample Pass@1 clustering.
  3. Code/data are released; DeepScaleR and MMLU-Pro have verifiable labels.
  4. DPO refresh reaches +7.6 points; weak-trained FutureProof is always negative.
  5. Audit target generators before replacing a judge.

1. 定位：保鲜期是响应、问题漂移，不是静态准确率。
  2. 抓手：弱/强生成器由 20 次采样 Pass@1 聚类。
  3. Artifact：代码数据已发；DeepScaleR、MMLU-Pro 有可验证标签。
  4. 证据：DPO 刷新最高 +7.6 点，弱训练 FutureProof 全为负。
  5. 决定：替换 judge 前先审计目标生成器。
